scientific_integrity: Theorem proof uses exact Fourier slicing and the prime Fourier-minor lemma. Finite test results corroborate but cannot certify arbitrary parameters. No experimental independence or external mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Prime translation field, faithful cyclic complement of order q at least 3 dividing p-1, and complete unweighted left-coset directions only; eigenvalue formulas for general q are explicit matrices and minors. The 2003 Scarabotti full text could not be reviewed and remains a historical equivalence risk. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sparse cyclic tomography on prime-affine groups
